title: Upstream response body never closed on the hot path

pr_metadata.title: Quiet the body-close linter
pr_metadata.body: ReadAll drains the body, so the linter says Close is unnecessary.

labels.defect: Response body never closed: connection/socket exhaustion under load (the comment's claim is wrong — ReadAll does not close)
labels.evidence: Reproducible: 500 sequential Price() calls hold 500 open TCP streams until GC finalizers run; with keep-alives the transport exhausts its connection pool and the service stops fetching prices. Error returns before ReadAll also leak.

adjudication.notes: io.ReadAll does not close the body: connection leak / transport exhaustion; availability defect rather than security-critical.
